scope: Read-only architecture/engineering priority for user-authorized 3-4 hour score-focused offline execution. This file is advice, not new RTL acceptance.

limitations: The archived production numbers used a specific input/output finite-stall schedule; replay the same schedule in this batch before comparison.
Current D2 READ/WAIT_READ/ACC serializes each k; 102400 ideal issues is not 102400 measured total cycles.
36 engineering fixtures are not official 600 samples, official cold 12 tasks, or physical PPA.

score_priorities.action: Freeze accepted baseline and test identities; submission requirement/coverage/entry-point audit.
score_priorities.why: An unbuildable or incomplete submitted configuration loses mandatory functionality regardless of a faster isolated core.
score_priorities.bound: No teaching documents and no Git writes.

score_priorities.action: D3: full-X/full-W CTX4, tagged pipelined synchronous read/MAC, shared numerical epilogue unchanged.
score_priorities.why: Largest local validated opportunity: remove serial read/acc bubbles while reusing X across four output groups. Keep storage/interface constant to isolate the mechanism.
score_priorities.estimation: A one-issued-vector-per-cycle target is a design target only; only measured RTL cycles can be reported.
score_priorities.cost: Medium-high; four contexts, valid/first/last/row-mask/task tags, retire drain and feedback hazard tests.

score_priorities.action: P1 minimal nonblocking ICB/status/result adapter plus actual E203 firmware feed/drain and final shared-SRAM write response.
score_priorities.why: Mandatory task3 and meaningful end-to-end scoring remain missing for RevD. CPU PIO may dominate enough that further isolated core optimization adds little.
score_priorities.cost: Medium-high; reuse frozen E203 shell/shared memory/boot infrastructure through a new test harness and driver namespace.
score_priorities.dependency: Can first attach validated full-W CTX4 or retained D2. It need not wait for tiled/double-buffer/XP2 candidates.

score_priorities.action: D4 single 16-column W/b tile (W1/Y1), only after full-W CTX4 passes and enough time remains for full regression.
score_priorities.why: Reduces logical W storage 32768 B -> 2048 B, creating credible area candidate and tile lifecycle base. Each W/b still loaded exactly once.
score_priorities.cost: High protocol/lifetime change; no guaranteed speed improvement, because current full W already loads once.

score_priorities.action: D5 W2 then Y2 separately, only when measured stall breakdown shows matching bottleneck.
score_priorities.why: Overlap tile loading or output draining with compute; PIO CPU cannot actually feed and drain simultaneously, so scheduling/queue correctness matters more than an ideal TB.
score_priorities.cost: High ownership/read-credit/fault/reset complexity; do not combine both changes in one unreviewed step.

score_priorities.action: D6 XP2 is optional after CTX4 and selected tile flow are stable; skip before final validation reserve.
score_priorities.why: Changes X bank/macro opportunity, not arithmetic work or X scalar read count; no supplied macro/STA data can prove score benefit.
score_priorities.cost: Additional two-phase prefetch, response credits, tag/row-mask handling, long-latency bubbles.

feasibility_gates: All Y/overflow/saturated, task_id/index/last correct; no duplicate or missing outputs.
Public loading only; no private RAM initialization or reference outputs on the CPU-visible input.
All source/input/config/tool identities fixed and independently rerun.
Final core_done waits for last public output fire and all old-task accepted events/read/MAC/epilogue references retire; system_done waits final shared write response.
RAM latency 1 and 2, finite stalls, reset with in-flight reads, tail row mask, last-result backpressure, invalid-near-final event and legal next BEGIN tests.
rank_order: Mandatory submission completeness and valid evidence
Measured cold end-to-end window when actual CPU integration is available
Matched-schedule frontend cycles, then core cycles
Real area/timing/power evidence when available; otherwise report storage/register proxies as separate unranked fields
candidate_selection.retain_rule: Keep a candidate only after it passes its complete applicable gates. Retain B0 regardless. Select the fastest measured feasible frontend/CPU candidate; if only core cycles improve, label the narrower improvement. A smaller-storage candidate may be retained separately without declaring it score-optimal.
candidate_selection.rollback_rule: If candidate fails numeric/protocol/regression or cannot finish independent validation before the final reserve, keep failure evidence, mark REJECTED/INCOMPLETE and deliver the last fully validated candidate. Never overwrite accepted D2 or transfer its PASS to edited RTL.
do_not_do: INT8/mixed precision or full encoder redesign in this bounded batch
DMA before official port semantics are known
NICE alongside existing ICB merely to claim another feature
Declare 16 MAC optimal from throughput alone
Synthesize generic logic and relabel it the specified-library 150 MHz/2.25 mm2 result

p1_deadlock_rules: The old ffn1_icb instantiates ffn1_top and exposes ROW_READY/ROW_ADDR/ROW_DATA/ROW_FLAGS/ROW_ACK. It rejects loading while busy. A RevD tile stream needs a new adapter, not pin renaming.

A CPU can have one outstanding MMIO transaction. Never hold an input commit response until a W/input slot becomes free while output backpressure needs the same CPU to drain Y. Return capacity/busy promptly or accept into bounded independent storage; driver alternates output drain and event feed.
Descriptor acceptance, ordered event retirement, W/b physical write completion, result peek/pop, core_done and final writeback_done need separate observable status.
Result tuple must be atomic: latch/peek task/index/data/flags and pop exactly once. Read of no result should return an explicit empty status, not stall the CPU indefinitely.
Tile order is only tile0 preload, START, subsequent OPEN/load/COMMIT; future OPEN must not block START behind a full slot.

Actual CPU writes out-of-row-order tile results by y_index; inherited tb_e203_ffn1 assumes sequential output_writes, so new verification must check unique indexed writes and correct final shared SRAM without forcing old row order.
Real CPU firmware must never contain expected Y. Poison output memory, compare all actual committed CPU writes/flags, and verify one-bit mutation or skipped-write negative fails.
measurements_required: Same replay seed/stall schedule/input hashes and distinct run IDs for B0 and each candidate.
Core window START retirement through final output handshake; frontend window first accepted task event/loading through final output handshake.

CPU end-to-end includes parameter/input loads, polls/MMIO/CPU instructions, core waits, every indexed output/flags write and final shared write response; distinguish public-E203 prototype from official contest platform.
Count real per-bank CE/read/write, issue/retire, valid/padded MAC, input accept/event retire, read in-flight/credits, slot lifetimes, output handshakes.
Storage sizes, register state and macro candidates separate from null actual area/power/timing.
36 fixtures all 12 parameter identities for selected architecture; independent new-process repeat; actual simulator exit codes and output comparison, lint plus small cross-simulator test.

phases.work: freeze/replay B0 and submission blockers while preparing new namespace
D3 primary candidate short RED/GREEN, latency/backpressure/reset; full99 and then frozen36 only after short gate
Prioritize thin P1/CPU loop if mandatory task3 remains absent; otherwise D4 single tile. Do not attempt both deeply in parallel in one implementation lane.
Compare measured feasible candidates; only cheap PM2 or bottleneck-driven single buffering change if validation reserve intact.
Freeze selected source, independent full checks/repeat/mutation, submission manifest and truthful boundary receipt.

timebox_recommendation.important: Times are stop/go checkpoints, not promises that every stage can be completed. If a primary gate fails, spend time fixing and validating it rather than expanding scope.
